coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay South Block 15A (UCSF planned)

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary built from DataSF's official street centerlines; the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.

milestones.text: OCII's Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019) shows this lettered block (15A) in the 'UCSF' color; the Successor Agency's Dec 2015 property map (Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B, page 12, dated 11/04/15) shows block 15 as a single undivided grey block without UCSF color-coding

sources.title: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, December 2019; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf

changes.text: Block 15A's notes said the block is surface parking (satellite-confirmed) and designated for UCSF institutional use, citing only the 2019 land use map, which shows neither. They now say the parking is our own observation in USDA NAIP imagery and cite UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck (undeveloped, Block 15 – Housing), and the use is corrected from institutional to residential. The 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map for the undivided block and drops two unverifiable clauses.
changes.source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf)

record.notes: No building on this site as of UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck ('Undeveloped parcels remaining'); parked cars fill the block in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29), an imagery observation that no cited document states. The OCII plan's Dec 2019 Land Use Map colors this block 'UCSF' (no use type); UCSF's own June 2025 deck, citing its Long Range Development Plan, lists Block 15 as Housing. No specific project, developer, or timeline was found.
